code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    axis_r = next(r for r in range(h) if all(v == 3 for v in grid[r]))
    axis_c = next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 3 for r in range(h)))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 3:
                continue
            dr, dc = abs(r - axis_r), abs(c - axis_c)
            if dr % 2:
                fill = dc > 0 and dc % 2 == 0 and dc >= dr + 1
            else:
                fill = dc > 0 and (dc % 2 == 0 or (dc % 2 == 1 and dc < dr))
            if fill:
                out[r][c] = 4
    return out
'''
